messages:
anya: Heads-up — production alerts from two customers flagged malformed compat layer transforms this morning. I'm going to add lightweight "breadcrumbs" headers to trace how requests were rewritten.

jordan: ack. can you sketch the header shape? want to avoid PII and keep it short.

anya: plan: inject X-Compat-Breadcrumb: <step_id>|<probe_code>|<v.old=>v.new> where step_id is anon UUID, probe_code is short tag (e.g., 'env-wrap'), and mappings are only model IDs. no user id or prompt content. example:
```
X-Compat-Breadcrumb: 7f2c|env-wrap|m456->m789
```

infra-bot: deploy scheduled to infra-staging at 11:30 UTC (job 4721). :white_check_mark:

sam: can we also emit a sampled trace to jaeger with breadcrumb id? otherwise correlating logs across services will be painful.

anya: yes — sample rate 1% by default, override via header X-Sample=1 for debug. store breadcrumb id as tag on span.

maria: need an opt-out flag for private tenants (PII regs). add header X-Compat-Breadcrumb: OMIT when tenant opts out.

jordan: thought: what if clients already set X-Compat-Breadcrumb? Should we namespace like X-RW-Compat-Breadcrumb to avoid collisions?

anya: good point. switch to X-RW-Compat-Breadcrumb. also update envoy filter to preserve incoming values and append our step (comma-separated) instead of overwrite.

kevin: rollout plan? feature flag + 48hr monitor + auto rollback? add metric compat.breadcrumb.rewrites and compat.breadcrumb.errors.

anya: feature flag via ff-service toggle, staged to 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 6h. alerts on error rate spike > 0.5% or latency +10ms p95.

sam: please add a small debug endpoint that returns the breadcrumbs for a request (only accessible internally) to validate rewriting logic.

anya: created PR #4123 with tests and envoy config diff. @jordan can you review? link: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/4123

jordan: will review this afternoon. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: deploy to staging succeeded (job 4721) — logs at https://logs.redwood/4721 (reaction :eyes:)

maria: one more ask — add a short TTL to breadcrumbs stored in traces (12h) to avoid retention blowup.

anya: ack. will add TTL and note in the PR.

kevin: thanks all. keep thread updated if we see customer regressions.
